title: EGPA — Escritório Galego-Português Antigo
institution: Universidade de Santiago de Compostela (HERES project; direction Ricardo Pichel, now Universidad de Alcalá) with GITHE, UNED
notes: Open collaborative platform of transcribed Galician-Portuguese archival documents (EGPAdoc) and literary texts (EGPAlit) from the Middle Ages to the 19th century, with paleographic and critical presentation; freely readable without login; per-document TEI at corpora.uah.es/egpa/xmlfiles/<id>.xml (checked EGPAdoc-0061). Most material is 12th-15th century; only a handful of documents dated 1478-1566 fall within 1450-1700. Word and text counts are left out: the statistics page (146 files, 83,821 tokens, all periods) includes test files and some 19th-century Castilian items, and only a handful of documents fall within 1450-1700.
